note: THE S9d REAL-PATH WALK, executable (cinatra#2788, PR #2939 round 2).
Round 2 shot four cells on one real run and could register none of them: it drove its own
Playwright file, so nothing it produced was a recorder observation, and an index record's
assertions are observations or they are inventions. This file is that same walk written in the
shape the recorder drives — `scripts/audit/lib/chat-hitl-capture-driver.mjs --walk` — so the
next pass over this path writes records instead of only pictures.
IT SAYS WHERE TO STAND AND WHAT TO PRESS. It never says what was seen: every assertion in every
record it produces is counted off the live page by `observeCapture`, and a cell that does not
come out fails AT THE CELL rather than at the end of a round nobody can repeat.
NOTHING HERE IS SEEDED. The schedule is STATED by typing a sentence into the shipped composer;
the scripted model bridge answers it by calling the shipped producer `schedule_proposal_render`
over self-MCP; the proposal ref is the product's own. That is why the sentence is an action and
the thread has no address in this file — the product mints it, and the dark context FOLLOWS the
light one to wherever it landed.
TWO PASSES, because the clock is real. `PROPOSAL_TTL_SECONDS = 1800`: the expired reading is
reached by letting the shipped window actually run out, not by moving a clock. Pass 1 starts
that window and walks C1/C2; pass 2 runs after it has elapsed and walks C3/C5.
export WALK_BASE=... WALK_COOKIE=... WALK_TEMPLATE_ID=...
node scripts/audit/lib/chat-hitl-capture-driver.mjs --walk evidence/2788-s9d-rework/capture-walk.json \
--steps expired-clock,state-the-schedule,follow-dark,confirm,confirm-dark
# ...after the window elapses, with WALK_RUN_ID and WALK_EXPIRED_THREAD read from the lane:
node scripts/audit/lib/chat-hitl-capture-driver.mjs --walk evidence/2788-s9d-rework/capture-walk.json \
--steps run-page,run-page-dark,expired,expired-dark
THE LANE SUPPLIES THE IDS, NOT THIS FILE. `${WALK_BASE}`, `${WALK_COOKIE}`, `${WALK_TEMPLATE_ID}`,
`${WALK_RUN_ID}` and `${WALK_EXPIRED_THREAD}` are the operator's environment. A committed plan
carrying a host, a port, a session or one lane's row ids is a leak and a plan the next lane
cannot run. The run id is the one thing pass 2 reads out of the lane's own `agent_runs`, which
is the same source every row of TIMELINE.md is read from.
EVERY CELL IS `window`-FRAMED. That is the maintainer's first rejection of round 1 turned into a
declaration the record carries: the browser window as the operator sees it — the navigation, both
conversation turns and the composer around the card — not the scrolled-out document.
C4 IS ABSENT AND STAYS ABSENT. It asked for the review page carrying THIS run's real artifact
review, and this run has none: Run now released the schedule and the run materialized a
SETUP-INPUT gate, so an artifact review would need the agent to run past it with a real model
provider. A lane that may hold one owns that cell. A stand-in is never acceptable, so there is
no C4 step here to accidentally answer with the wrong screen.
